newsitem.title: DUBAI: Haj fire not deliberate - Saudi minister.
newsitem.headline: Haj fire not deliberate - Saudi minister.

text.p: The fire which killed 343 Moslem pilgrims and injured more than 1,500 near Mecca last month was an accident, Saudi Arabia's interior minister said.
The minister, Prince Nayef, said an investigating commission had concluded the blaze was not started deliberately, the official Saudi Press Agency reported on Tuesday.
The agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation, said the conclusion was reached on the basis of eyewitness accounts, forensic tests, reports from security services and other evidence.

Prince Nayef said the fire, which swept through 70,000 tents at Mena, 11 km (seven miles) from Mecca on April 18, started when a pilgrim on the annual haj to Islam's holiest site tried to cook a meal on a gas fire inside his tent.
The tent caught fire and, partly due to strong winds, spread to other tents despite efforts by pilgrims, security services and civil defence forces.
